description: Coded 64-BQ; served with the 64e Escadre de Transport at Evreux-Fauville with regular detachments to BA 188 Djibouti, and flew from Chateaudun to Toulouse in 1984. Owned by Ailes Anciennes Toulouse but physically displayed at the entrance to the Camp de Caylus in the Tarn-et-Garonne, which is where a visitor would find it.
